summary: Tiny, very steep kerb in a narrow lane beside an apartment block.
reasons: Grade about 23%, far over the limit
Narrow lane, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: The Axis Taringa apartment block runs the whole east side, 7 m away; shops and a house on the west.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 12 m of kerb in a narrow service lane between buildings; no clear ground beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Shop and apartment access lane with customer car parks nearby.
drivers.convention: Signed 2P parallel, Mon-Fri 9am-4pm; no overnight parking pattern seen.

sun_shade: Mostly shaded by the apartment block to the east in the morning.
